decisions.reason: As a recently launched conferencing service adjacent to core telecom offerings, management can still blame weak uptake on a temporary ramp-up and stick with the initial commitment.
The specific adoption signal on the website and the infrastructure investment behind a metro data-centre network make management very reluctant to reverse course.
A product with its own webpage and clear optical-connectivity positioning reflects visible public commitment and likely high sunk costs, which favors persistence.
Because this portal supports the established voice business and was only just introduced, management is likely to keep it and argue that customer adoption still needs time.
Carrier pre-selection is a more legacy-style telephony offer with weaker strategic fit and only limited visible commitment, so it is the easiest product for management to discontinue.
A direct voice network connection service remains close to the firm's core enterprise telecom activity, so recent launch commitments and integration logic favor keeping it.
